answer: The thread register is checked at draw time, sparrow lists the eligible set, and comet seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 43 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 43 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 11 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
